description: Q&A script for presentation generator expediter questions

entries._comment: The OPEN-ENDED DESCRIBE-IT ask (row 0c280989), keyed on the ask's own id rather than its wording. It is the sibling of the document_choice card: the card appears when 2..cap candidates match, this appears when the expeditor has to ask which document at all. Six copies across six profiles had drifted into three different wordings, so a change in _handle_fuzzy_file_match would have silently unanswered some and not others. The id is matched exactly, narrowed by the `agents` tag and by arg_name, before the model is asked anything. THE ANSWER IS DELIBERATELY PER-PROFILE and must not be collapsed: these are fixture choices for standalone profiles, not divergence.

entries.question_pattern: How long should the presentation be in minutes? Say a number, or 'default' for 15 minutes.
Who is the target audience? Options: beginner, general, expert, or academic.
Any additional context about the audience? Say 'none' to skip.
Which presentation theme? Say 'default' or a theme name.

entries._comment: The DOCUMENT CHOICE CARD, keyed on the card's own id rather than its wording (row a1420538). This entry is GENERIC: every agent with a file-typed argument shows the same card, and the card names itself via card_id in response_options, so nothing here mentions podcasts or presentations and a new agent needs no new entry. It used to key on question_pattern — the question the expeditor derives per calling agent — which forced one byte-identical copy per agent and meant a wording change silently left the card unanswered. The match on card_id is exact and happens BEFORE the model is asked anything. The answer is a POSITIONAL SENTINEL, not a value: option labels are candidate basenames discovered at run time, so no fixed string could ever equal one; cosa/agents/notification_proxy/option_sentinels.py turns it into a real label from the options that arrive with the notification, skipping the Describe and Cancel escapes.

entries.question_pattern: Would you like to proceed with these settings?
